purpose: Run the project-persistent self-development workflow through an Import Orchestrator-owned campaign, Intent Regulator liveness supervision, campaign-owned repair, fresh replacement, and independent clearance.

intent_regulator.responsibility: Supervise the Import Orchestrator's workflow health, preserve failures, classify boundaries, repair safe liveness gaps, and decide whether the whole process is moving toward intent without taking ownership of project work.

runtime.responsibility: Keep the control-plane records and timer available across temporary worker cycling.

orchestrator.responsibility: Own the project-bound import plan, derive wave order, prepare and QA-gate typed lifecycle requests, direct admitted campaign workers, keep each worker in one named lane, preserve custody and handoffs, collect repairs, and advance the candidate through integration. Agent creation and archival are requested from and executed only by the Spawner.

auditor.responsibility: Independently audit the campaign, report unresolved repair or boundary findings, and never accept its own work.

cadence.timer_rule: At each expiry the Intent Regulator inspects every active worker's scope, exact source identity, evidence, handoff, and progress signal. Runtime and Intent Regulator are inspected but never cycled.
cadence.same_turn_repair_resolution: The runner may resolve a repair-required observation in the same turn through a typed resolver that supplies the predecessor, repair, replacement, and independent-clearance evidence; it must never silently wait for cadence.
cadence.same_turn_bound_failure: If repeated replacements exhaust the same-turn bound, emit a typed AGENTOS_CONTINUOUS_LOOP_REPLACEMENT_BOUND_EXHAUSTED event or throw that exact failure; never return a silent closeout.

worker_naming.format: <clear role or lane> v<version>-tb-<two-digit test build>
worker_naming.rule: Every temporary Orchestrator, Auditor, and worker display name carries the exact version and test-build tag of the governance it is using.

inspection.meaningful_result: Only a source-bound result with a typed handoff counts as meaningful progress.

repair_replacement.predecessor_rule: A replacement is invalid without the predecessor's exact typed handoff and session identity.
repair_replacement.closure_rule: A replacement is not complete until host receipts prove visible creation, pin, send, wait, read, unpin, archive, post-close readback, and active-roster absence.
repair_replacement.host_failure_retention: A missing, malformed, failed, or thrown host receipt is preserved as a workflow record with its phase, opaque error digest, and raw-receipt digest; raw host text never enters the durable record and the failure never becomes success.
repair_replacement.host_receipt_binding: Every named host receipt is content-addressed and binds its operation name, replacement session, observation time, exact source commit/tree, and meaningful-progress flag. The read receipt additionally binds the typed handoff and must prove meaningful progress.

goal_transitions.source_or_intent_change: Close the current goal as SUCCEEDED_BY_REASSESSMENT and mint a replacement goal bound to the observed exact source and intent.
goal_transitions.hard_boundary: STOP_HARD_BOUNDARY; preserve evidence and do not continue or mint a worker replacement.
goal_transitions.soft_boundary: SOFT_BOUNDARY_REVIEW; the Orchestrator may continue unrelated safe work but the dependent route waits for review.
goal_transitions.puzzle: ORCHESTRATOR_REPAIR; ordinary engineering problems stay within the admitted AgentOS scope.
goal_transitions.true_blocker: INTENT_REGULATOR_REVIEW; the Orchestrator cannot silently turn an identity, evidence, or authority blocker into success.

execution_binding.model_and_reasoning: The admitted model and reasoning binding are typed data supplied by the campaign; the portable loop does not select or name a provider-specific model.
